name: Grotesque Guardians

mechanics.name: Dawn's Barrage
mechanics.description: Dawn stays airborne and throws two ranged hits at a time, dropping to a melee kick if you are underneath her.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Missiles, and swap to Melee when she comes down for the kick.

mechanics.name: Stone Ball
mechanics.description: Dawn lobs a stone ball that lands across a three by three patch and stuns whoever it catches for ten ticks.
mechanics.counterplay: Step out of the marked tiles. A stun here means eating every attack that follows.

mechanics.name: Dusk's Slash
mechanics.description: Dusk fights on the ground and is immune to magic and ranged. He tramples anyone standing directly beneath him.
mechanics.counterplay: Bring a melee weapon, ideally one that hits several times. Do not stand under him.

mechanics.name: Wing Sweep
mechanics.description: Dusk's wing starts glowing, then he sweeps it across the ground, knocking you back and hitting hard.
mechanics.counterplay: Move one tile the moment the wing lights up.

mechanics.name: Lightning and Orbs
mechanics.description: The pair charge lightning together, leaving vortices that burn anyone standing on or beside them, and three energy spheres appear in stages. Any sphere Dusk absorbs at full charge heals him heavily.
mechanics.counterplay: Stand clear of every vortex, and grab the spheres at whatever charge they are at rather than letting him have them.

mechanics.name: Empowered Dusk
mechanics.description: Dusk comes back far stronger and gains a ranged attack to go with his melee. He drags you into a three by three cage of blue flame, and the damage it deals heals him.
mechanics.counterplay: Leave through the one tile with no flame within five ticks. On later drags, attack him to path out.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). THIS PAGE COVERS TWO NPCS, WHICH IS WHY npcIds IS LONG. Dusk and Dawn are separate npcs that both transform repeatedly through the fight (Dusk alone has eight ids, Dawn four), and every one of them has to be tracked as the boss for its animations to keep matching (docs/DECISIONS.md D17). 15621 through 15623 are a second copy of the pair carrying different models but the same animations, and are included on the same reasoning as the clan cup and Deadman copies already shipped for the God Wars generals. Animations are the complete GG_DAWN_* and GG_DUSK_* sets, all unambiguous gameval names, and this is the most thoroughly named boss in the wave: attack, defensive-stance variant, wing extend and retract, enrage and enraged-attack all have their own ids. Where a move has both an ordinary and a defensive-stance sequence, both are curated as triggers on the same mechanic (7786 with 7785, 7788 with 7787), since they are the same move played from a different stance. Projectile GG_FALLING_PROJECTILE 1435 is curated on the stone ball because its name carries an explicit projectile suffix, which is the bar for a projectile trigger in this wave. THE SIXTEEN LIGHTNING SPOTANIMS ARE DELIBERATELY LEFT OUT. GG_DUSK_LIGHTNING_1 through _8 (1416 to 1423) and GG_DAWN_LIGHTNING_1 through _8 (1424 to 1431), plus GG_DAWN_LIGHTNING_DEATH 1432, GG_DUSK_LIGHTNING_DAWN_DEATH 1433 and GG_DUSK_LIGHTNING_ENRAGED 1434, are graphics rather than projectiles, and a graphic trigger has no source actor to check (D17) while discovery never revokes (D18). The lightning mechanic detects on the two charge animations instead, which is the safe half of the same event. THE ORB HEALING IS FOLDED INTO THE LIGHTNING MECHANIC rather than given its own row: the spheres appear as part of the same phase and the cache names no separate animation for them. Zoom and shiftY are FitZoom output at the shipped 291x140 box plus the standard 10% margin; none of the six needed the zoom correction the flying and oversized models in the God Wars batch did, despite Dawn being airborne, because her model still reaches the ground line. The lightning preview at zoom 4167 is the widest fit in the file. staticFallback is false on all six; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Grotesque Guardians', matching 'name'.
